purpose: Exact construction template for single-use HUMAN-GO evidence. The agent must materialize only these fields, validate against the bound schema, persist it, and verify provider readback before building a claim state.
rules: Do not add, rename or omit fields.
identityRevision and targetDispatchRevision are integers after materialization.
activationId must be unique for this HUMAN GO and not already consumed.
The materialized evidence must validate against targetSchemaRef before persistence.
Provider readback of the exact persisted evidence is required before Agent-State claim construction.
